python3 -c "
import sys, importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('a','.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
for name in ('input.md','output.md'):
    t=open(name,encoding='utf-8').read()
    d=m.Doc(t)
    kinds={}
    for b in d.blocks: kinds[b.kind]=kinds.get(b.kind,0)+1
    paras=[b for b in d.blocks if b.kind=='para']
    sents=sum(len(m.split_sentences(m.prose_of(b), d.lang)) for b in paras)
    print(name, 'blocks=',len(d.blocks), kinds, 'para=',len(paras), 'prose_sentences=',sents, 'lines=',len(d.lines))
"
input.description: Count blocks, paragraphs and sentences in both files
